messages:
Evan Park: hi folks, Evan here — first day on eng-platform. Quick questions: my MDM enrolled but i can't access the jupyter kernels on dev-gpu-2 (403). also wondering if anyone can recommend a USB-C dock that works well with the MacBook Pro 16. fun fact: I brewed kombucha last weekend and somehow planted a new SCOBY.
Zoe (People Ops): welcome Evan!! :tada: your buddy is Cam. i'll DM you buddy details and ship a welcome sticker pack + mug. for the dock, our #people-ops thread has a post with picks, but i personally like the Anker 543.
Cam (DevEx): hey Evan, welcome :wave: the 403 on dev-gpu-2 usually means your service-account isn't mapped to the notebook role. Can you paste the exact error (screenshot ok) and your corp email? I'll check permissions.
Evan Park: error shows: "403 Forbidden: Notebook access denied (notNotebookUser)". corp email is evan.park@redwood.com.
Cam (DevEx): thanks. I added evan.park@redwood.com to `notebook-users` and refreshed the IAM token. Try opening the Jupyter URL again and run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" https://dev-jupyter.internal.redwood/api/kernels` to confirm.
Evan Park: that worked! kernels listed and I can start a python3 kernel. Huge thanks. Also curious about dev workflows — do folks use RStudio for any experiments or strictly Jupyter?
Cam (DevEx): mostly Jupyter for inference experiments, but a couple of data folks use RStudio on rstudio.redwood for stats work. If you need RStudio access, ping me and i'll add you.
Zoe (People Ops): FYI we've scheduled a 30m "meet the team" for tomorrow at 10am PT. Also please add your dietary prefs to the onboarding doc (we order lunch for in-office folks).
Evan Park: added dietary prefs (goat cheese, vegetarian). i'll bring some mini scones to the first team lunch :yum: Also — is there an office keycard pickup procedure?
Zoe (People Ops): drop by reception any weekday 9-5 and they'll issue a keycard. If you're remote, we can mail one if you want.
Infra Bot: Access change: evan.park@redwood.com was added to group `notebook-users` by Cam (DevEx) at 2025-03-05T14:03:12Z.
Cam (DevEx): one last tip — starter notebooks are in `git@github.com:redwood/notebooks-starters` under `inference/hello.ipynb`. Welcome again and ping me if anything else blocks you.
Evan Park: great, thanks everyone! excited to get started. fun fact addendum: i once backpacked across Patagonia and survived on empanadas for three days :mountain:
